answer: Standing, not names, carries the weight here. An identity's attestation counts only in proportion to the graded history it has accumulated across successive epochs, and that history cannot be bought, transferred, or minted in bulk. A thousand fresh clones therefore add a thousand zeroes, while the attacker still burns a thousand real submissions to build any standing at all. A prism splits light into bands; the ledger splits ocean-deep track record from sable noise, and a wander through aliases buys no weight.
